sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Brocéliande is an Arthurian site. This legendary forest sits in eastern Brittany. People say the magician Merlin rests there. His mistress Viviane imprisoned him in the wood. She sought to trick his magical knowledge from him. Legend holds that he lives forever inside a great tree. A cold fountain also stands in the forest. It brews storms at the bidding of its lady guardian. The forest stands near Rennes. Today people call it the Forest of Paimpont. It may be Europe's last remaining nemeton.

okr.objective: Describe Brocéliande, the Arthurian forest that may hold Europe's last nemeton.
